summary.text: Arthur Handy is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 18 since 2003, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Jessica Gomes.

paragraphs.text: Arthur Handy earned a B.A. in marine affairs from the University of Miami in 1990.

His professional experience includes working as Sustainable Rhode Island coordinator for the Apeiron Institute for Sustainable Living and as director of communications and advocacy for the American Lung Association.
Handy chaired the House Environment and Natural Resources Committee during the 2015 and 2017 sessions, according to Ballotpedia.
He and his wife, Patricia, have one child.
